description:
FILED s473t6d member 4 (Opus, 2026-09-20, finished s493).  PRE-EXISTING: measured
IDENTICAL on the batch tree and on a `git archive 268d7e00` extraction.

`tools/run-perl-suite.pl` compares a run's diverging rows against
baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv through PclTapAlign::rowkey_desc, which strips the
perl t/ directory out of an unnamed test's `[at <file> line N]` description.  Five
blessed rows were written BEFORE that projection reached them, so the key they
carry is one the projection can never produce:

  re/pat_rt_report.t  4 rows spelled with the ABSOLUTE build path
      `[at /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/build/perl-5.40.3/perl-5.40.3/t/re/pat_rt_report.t line 963]`
      (and 964, 965, `line 1008] # TODO [perl #38133]`)
    where every run produces `[at t/re/pat_rt_report.t line 963]`.
    NOTE the absolute path also bakes THIS MACHINE's perlbrew root into a
    checked-in baseline -- the task #217 family.

  op/lex.t  1 row spelled `Various tests of string delims \xAB/\xBB returned
    without error` where perl's own TAP carries the RAW bytes (0xAB, 0xBB).

Both show up as a NEW ROW **and** a FIXED ROW of the same test on every companion
run, on any tree:

    tree  ROW DIFF ... NEW ROW by file: re/pat_rt_report.t 4, op/lex.t 1
    base  ROW DIFF ... NEW ROW by file: re/pat_rt_report.t 4, op/lex.t 1

Logs: scratch/s473t6d/ab/{tree,base}-light.log.

FIX: re-spell the five rows to the key projection (a mechanical edit, but it is
not this round's to make -- the round did not cause them).  Worth doing before
the next companion round, because five permanent phantom NEW ROWs train the
reader to skim the bucket that is supposed to be zero.


=== DONE (Fable, s494, 2026-09-21) ===
THE TASK UNDERCOUNTED BY A FACTOR OF 35: not 5 rows but **178**.  MEASURED (`tools/run-perl-suite.pl --jobs 1` over the affected files, logs ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s494/c1966/run.log, run2.log, run3.log): the five files alone read **159 NEW ROW + 159 FIXED ROW** on every run (re/regexp_normal.t 128, re/subst.t 14, re/subst_amp.t 12, re/pat_rt_report.t 4, op/lex.t 1), re/pat.t carried 11 more of the path class and 8 of the escape class -- s473t6d`s leg simply did not include regexp_normal / subst / subst_amp.  ALL 169 path rows entered in ONE commit, `97190ddc` (s473t5e, 2026-09-13, the re/ cause census): its script rebuilt rows from the faillog`s RAW descriptions, which carry this machine`s absolute perl build path; the runner projects every run-side key through PclTapAlign::rowkey_desc (`$tdir/` -> `t/`), so those keys could never match.  So for eight days every companion run over re/ was NOT CLEAN by construction.
FIX: the KEY column re-spelled through the ONE projection itself (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s494/c1966/respell.pl: every other column copied byte for byte; exactly 170 rows changed = 169 path rows + op/lex.t`s `\xAB/\xBB` -> the raw bytes perl`s TAP carries), then re/pat.t`s 8 rows whose key spelled `((\xC0)+,?)` as an escape where the TAP holds the raw byte C0.  AFTER: the five files 0 NEW / 0 FIXED; re/pat.t 5 NEW / 7 FIXED = #1965`s class only (descriptions that differ from run to run: the 20000-nodes string, the `(?il) locale` rows) -- NOT touched here.
GUARD (tools/t/perl-suite-causes.t, +1 row, 44 rows / 0.1 s): no blessed key holds an absolute path into a perl tree`s t/, and the projection is the IDENTITY on every blessed key; inverse-checked: the old baseline fails it with 169 keys.  The escape-spelling class (9 rows) has no mechanical guard -- a hand-typed key is only caught by the 0 NEW / 0 FIXED re-run every splice already owes.
STANDING NOTE for a census script: build baseline rows from the runner`s PROJECTED key (what `--bless-fails` writes), never from `.suitelog/*.fails.tsv``s raw description.
subject: Five blessed companion fail rows carry a PRE-NORMALISATION spelling and can NEVER match -- 5 phantom NEW ROWs on every run (re/pat_rt_report.t x4, op/lex.t x1)
